picker_desc: New tasks of the projects that start on this board copy it. A task runs in this column the agent it has assigned for it.
no_projects: No project starts on this board yet. A project that needs another agent here picks it in its template.

projects.one: Saved to the template of {count} project.
projects.other: Saved to the template of {count} projects.

cleared: {column} no longer has a default agent
start_end: Start and end columns run no agent.
board_picker_desc: Every new task on this board gets it, unless its project template or its task type names another.
